Signature Treatments

Fah Lanna Wisdom

Time Price
03:00 Hours 4,800 Baht

The new signature package to benefit your body, mind and spirit. It’s a unique package that includes elements of traditional Lanna culture such as “Wai Kru” ceremony, body balance checking with “Taleo” - a Lanna Symbol for protection - and movements with influences from traditional Thai dance. Package Details: Herbal Steam Bath, “Wai Kru Ceremony” to pay respect to the master of Thai Massage, Body Balance checking with “Taleo” - a Lanna symbol of protection, Betel Leaf Skin Detox, Thai Lanna Wisdom Massage, Herbal Ball Body & Herbal Ball Facial Massage, Dachanee Nang Massage and Body Movement with influences of Traditional Thai Dance.

Fah Lanna Karma (Reiki Healing)

Time Price
01:00 Hours 2,000 Baht

Reiki stems from Japanese : Rei means "The Higher Power" and Ki means "life force energy". Reiki promotes healing, reduces stress and helps relaxation. Reiki does not include massage. It is administered by "laying on hands" and is based on the idea that an "life force energy" flows through us. Reiki healing triggers the body’s natural healing abilities. Reiki healing is a natural therapy that gently balances life energies and brings health and well being to the recipient. REMARK: Available only between 12 pm and 4.30 pm. Advance reservation required to check availability.
